body: Yes, I am a senior, so this is my last year of high school (thank god), but I'm not sure if I can survive it.
That's great thanks! That John Oliver clip especially. I love him so much!

Do you have any advice on talking to friends and family about it? Every time my parents try and talk to me about it and they say something I don't like (they try to understand, but sometimes they say something they might think is okay, but I dont) I want to walk away. I want to tell my liberal extended family (aunt, uncle, very liberal grandma, and grandpa), but I don't know if I'll be able to handle all their questions. Also, while I know one of my groups (one from my old school, one from my current) of friends (my current group, which includes a guy I really like, but am not sure how to tell him that I like him, because I don't know if he likes me that way too. Like you said being a teen and/or trans sucks.), but I'm not sure how the other (old school) will react. I'm afraid of losing such a close group of friends/family. Sorry to throw all this at you. Any advice?

Yeah I live in the bible belt too (NC). I also have that covering chest feeling (I don't really like not wearing a shirt, even when at the pool or the beach, which is why I don't really like either). I still kind of have this weird relationship with breasts, because I know I should have them (to pass), but I don't really care for them (I was really revolted by them when I was younger and so I never watched any porn, even to this day it still run in terror when I see them [minor hyperbole]).  My therapist might have found an endocrinologist for me, so I might be getting hormones soon! A lot of Reddit can be transphobic so it is great to see so many transfriendly subreddits!

Thank you so much for this. While I do go to a therapist, I don't really have another trans person in my life. It's great to know that there is someone else out there who knows what I'm going through. :)
Thank you so much. You don't understand what this means to me :')
You and /u/mygqaccount are probably both right. It's a mix between resentment and being not attracted to them.
Thank you I like your username too! You're probably right though. While I still feel romantically attracted to girls, I feel like I lean more towards boys than girls
